cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a starship data archive — standing; A private wardrobe atelier in the station where theatrical dresses are fitted against a glowing mirror — She tests how far she can reach in the fitted outfit; a vast fantasy library of towering shelves — holds her keepsake at chest height; An orbital ceramics kiosk with drawers of glazed samples and a sunlit viewing niche — She turns a purple test tile under the light to see which part changes from silver to plum; an outdoor court for tennis or basketball — dries her hair with a towel; a neon-lit game arcade — standing; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — perched on a ledge or edge; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — standing; a city rooftop party under string lights — hugs a striped tub of popcorn against her side; a terrace on a castle wall overlooking the valley — kneeling on the ground; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; an open pavilion floating above a sea of clouds at sunrise — standing; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — standing
